messages:
arpita_partner_ops: Quick brainstorm: propose a 'renewal token' mechanism for marketplace private offers to smooth discounting and align HW rebates with committed spend. core goals: predictable partner payouts, lower month-to-month revenue variance for Redwood, clearer signal for SIs during launches.

matt_sales: sounds useful. how strict is the renewal condition? customers often have seasonal bursts.

arpita_partner_ops: idea is a tiered unlock: small token pool upfront (2-4% of MCV) + additional unlocks if avg monthly usage >= X% of commit over 90d. seasonal bursts allowed if baseline holds avg.

jen_legal: need language for token expiry, non-transferability, and treatment on contract termination. also define "avg usage" metric precisely (net of credits).

kai_hw: HW vendors care about when we trigger their rebate. can the token unlock be staged so rebates only pay out after the appliance share threshold is met? we can't pay rebates on token grants alone.

arpita_partner_ops: yes, rebate trigger = token vesting + appliance share >= 50% during vest window. token grants themselves are customer credits, rebate to HW is separate payable after verification.

nina_finance: suggestion: amortize token liability monthly. cap tokens per account (suggested cap = 3x monthly_commit or $5k floor). prefer monthly credit application to limit P&L shock.

leo_prod: from a UX standpoint we should show token balance and vest schedule in Console and in private-offer terms. also surface reason codes when tokens fail to vest.

matt_sales: field ask: sample language for partner sellers and a short FAQ. can we draft that for next week?

arpita_partner_ops: will draft. ops implications: billing needs token_balance, vest_schedule, rebate_eligible flag. plus export for partner reporting. minimal dev ETA 3 wks.

jen_legal: i'll draft clause templates. note on termination: unused tokens expire 180 days after grant unless renewal executed.

kai_hw: also need reconciliation cadence for rebates (quarterly with audit window). OEMs will want monthly visibility.

nina_finance: reconciliation monthly, payout quarterly seems reasonable. include reserve allowance for chargebacks.

ci_bot: CI job passed for docs-draft branch. preview site updated.

arpita_partner_ops: Pilot plan: 6-week pilot limited to 3 private offers (2 SI-driven, 1 OEM-bundled). Metrics: variance in MoM revenue, renewal uplift, dispute rate. If pilot looks good, scale.

matt_sales: i'll line up 2 SI pilots. jen please confirm legal drafts by EOD Friday?

jen_legal: i'll have draft clauses by Friday COB.

arpita_partner_ops: Great. Quick config snippet for engineering/docs (copyable):

```
renewal_token_config:
  upfront_percent: 0.03        # 3% of monthly committed value
  vest_days: 90
  appliance_share_threshold: 0.50
  token_cap_formula: "max(monthly_commit * 3, 5000)"
  expiry_days: 180
  credit_apply: "monthly_on_invoice"
  rebate_payout: "quarterly_after_reconciliation"
```

arpita_partner_ops: thanks team — follow-ups: matt (partner signups), kai (OEM reconciliation spec), nina (P&L cap confirmation), leo (Console UX stub). will reconvene next Tues. :calendar:
